Wtf? Barbarian isn't OP...its like .5 hearts more damage each hit. I don't have a problem with fighting barbarians with warrior.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
1. Mining fatigue slows down your swing and makes you hit slower

2. Diamond swords do 7 damage. Iron do 6.  Also: 2 damage = 1 heart. So 7/2 (diamond) and 6/2 (iron) = 3.5 hearts and 3 hearts respectively.

3. "You shouldn't get good kits by leveling up" So you are saying we should spend all our time leveling up, only to get a kit that is just as powerful as the one we just used for 30 levels? Sorry, but a huge waste of time.
